description:
Adds a customer, or a job under one: set `parent_ref` to the customer and the job's `full_name` becomes `Parent:Job`. `name` is required. QuickBooks keeps customers, vendors, employees and other names in one name space, so a name any of them already uses fails with 3100 `name_in_use`. The `ensure` workflow template adds the customer only if it isn't there yet, and on a clash finds out what holds the name and asks.

The `customer_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3100 name_in_use, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account
